questions.prompt: How does the store persist learner progress, and what happens when storage misbehaves?

keyPoints.text: All progress is one versioned blob under one key, which keeps migrations possible.
keyPoints.quote: one versioned blob under one key, so migrations are possible;

keyPoints.text: Every write goes through save(), so the persisted copy cannot drift from memory by a forgotten write.
keyPoints.quote: every write goes through `save()`, so nothing can drift;

keyPoints.text: Subscribers are notified on save, which keeps the header XP pill live.
keyPoints.quote: subscribers are notified, which is how the header XP pill stays live.

keyPoints.text: Corrupt or unreadable storage falls back to an empty state instead of crashing.
keyPoints.quote: Corrupt or unavailable storage should never brick the app.

keyPoints.text: A failed write is swallowed, so progress silently does not persist in private mode or when the quota is full.
keyPoints.quote: private mode / quota - progress simply will not persist

keyPoints.text: load() deep-merges settings with defaults, so new settings get default values for old saves.

questions.prompt: Walk through what one recorded answer changes: answer stats, the spaced-repetition card, XP and the streak.

keyPoints.text: The per-question streak grows on a correct answer and resets to zero on a wrong one.
The SRS card is rescheduled, using an explicit grade when given or 2/0 from correctness.
A miss resets the card's reps and interval and brings it back in ten minutes.
Correct answers earn 10 XP and attempts still earn 2.
The daily streak only continues when the gap since the last active day is exactly one.
Reading a lesson pays 5 XP only the first time.

questions.prompt: How do the derived views decide mastery, what is due, and what counts as a weak spot?

keyPoints.text: Two clean answers in a row make a question mastered.
keyPoints.quote: Two clean answers in a row = mastered.

keyPoints.text: Question mastery is the streak divided by two, clamped to 0..1.
Module mastery averages question mastery; track mastery averages modules that have questions.
Only questions already answered can be due for review.
A weak question was missed last time or has more wrong than right answers.
keyPoints.quote: Questions answered wrong more often than right, or missed most recently.

keyPoints.text: Levels need 250 XP at first and each level needs 15% more.
